LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Four enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck!

Shoot Your Friends
Take a seat at the new 4-way multiplayer table. Bargain. Beg. Betray. Become the ultimate victor. Walk away rich.


12-Gauge Action
Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge. Cause shotguns just feel better.


Literally Mindblowing Gameplay
15 to 20-minute intense playtime. Enter the arena, go three rounds against The Dealer, and walk away with the prize. Or don't.


Immersive Atmosphere
Welcome to the underground nightclub, where metal railings pulse to the beats of forgotten drum machines.


Meet Your Match
Face off against The Dealer, playing the odds same as you. No tricks. Can you beat him at his own game?


Double or Nothing
Press your luck in the new Double or Nothing mode. How long can you last?
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Four enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck!

LocalizedProperties.ReleaseNotes:
General / UI

Removed the mouse cursor icon from the Settings menu on Xbox.


Dealer's Table / Item Balance
Fixed the Dealer receiving very few items after reaching 500K–1M points in Double or Nothing.
Fixed the Dealer's table occasionally exceeding item caps. Corrected caps in Double or Nothing and Story Mode.
Fixed the Handsaw being drawable on round 1 of 2-HP batches.
Fixed the Dealer's phone occasionally revealing the current shell.
Fixed Adrenaline appearing in excessive quantities in Endless mode.


Multiplayer
Fixed 4-player matches not starting at 5 max HP.
Fixed a softlock when using Adrenaline with no valid item to steal.
Fixed rare mid-round freezes caused by disconnects during item/shooting animations.


Localization
Fixed Turkish, Russian, and Ukrainian language settings not saving between sessions.
Fixed Spanish (LATAM) never loading, which was defaulting to Spanish (Spain).
Fixed disclaimer text always using system language, now it uses the selected language in the language menu.
Fixed letter/number size inconsistency in item descriptions (Russian/Ukrainian).
Fixed oversized Escape/Menu text (Russian/Ukrainian).
